messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: spike in 5xxs on /v1/generate from smart-routing fallback. Affected region: us-west-2 -> eus1 fallback path. Error rate 23% over 3m. Trigger: routing_policy/fallback/error-threshold.

maria (oncall): I'm on it, paging @akash and @jess. Acknowledge.

akash (sre): looking. grabbing logs and routing state now. can anyone confirm there was a canary rollout started ~10:12 UTC?

jess (prod): yes started at 10:12, canary 12% traffic to model variant `llama-35b-v2-quant`. Rollout config: `rollout: canary, sticky_fallback: true, fallback_variant: v1-32q`.

akash (sre): there it is — fallback is sticky to `v1-32q` but the canary variant uses a different KV-cache schema. When a request hits canary, it writes preds with header `kvv2`. Fallback requests expect `kvv1` -> decoder throws -> 500. Sticky fallback sticky=true means some sessions keep getting routed to the incompatible fallback variant.

maria (oncall): can we reproduce locally? sample failing request:

```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -d '{"model":"canary-llama-35b-v2-quant","input":"hello"}'
# response: HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error\n# body: {"error":"kv cache mismatch: expected kvv1, got kvv2"}
```

akash (sre): thanks. Repro'd in a canary pod. root cause: model onboarding step didn't set `compatibility.kv_schema` in model catalog; rollout policy allowed sticky fallback to a variant with incompatible schema.

jess (prod): immediate mitigation options?

akash (sre): short-term: 1) pause the canary rollout (stop further traffic shift) 2) evict sticky sessions so existing sessions re-evaluate routing 3) set fallback.sticky=false for this policy to avoid persistent loops.

maria (oncall): pausing rollout via console now.

deploy-bot: Rollout pause request accepted by console. Rollout state -> PAUSED.

akash (sre): evicting sticky routes for selector `canary:llama-35b-v2-quant` now:
```
routesctl evict --selector "canary=llama-35b-v2-quant" --force
```

akash (sre): setting fallback.sticky=false and fallback.ttl=30s on the policy to allow quick re-routing. Applying patch.

jess (prod): applied policy change, confirmed via API.

maria (oncall): monitoring metrics... error rate dropped from 23% -> 4% in 90s. latency normalizing. Looks like evict + sticky=false worked.

evan (pm): customer impact? any users affected externally? ops dashboard shows elevated errors for two paying customers on the canary cohort for ~8 minutes. I've opened INC-2026-884 for customer notifications.

maria (oncall): created runbook task list in the incident ticket. Assigning postmortem to @akash. Severity assessed: P2 (partial outage for subset of traffic).

akash (sre): short-term mitigation complete. Next steps I propose:
- Rollback canary to previous stable `llama-35b-v1` while we fix model catalog metadata.
- Add admission check on rollout pipeline: reject canary if `compatibility.kv_schema` differs from fallback variants unless explicit override.
- Add metric/alert for sticky-fallback loops (increase in errors after fallback events).

jess (prod): rollback initiated via deploy-bot.

deploy-bot: Rollback job started for canary group `llama-35b`. ETA ~3m.

maria (oncall): rollback completed. traffic back to stable. Errors down to baseline.

evan (pm): logging summary for customers, will coordinate outreach with CS.

akash (sre): root cause summary for postmortem: onboarding step omitted compatibility metadata -> policy allowed sticky fallback across incompatible variants -> session stickiness caused repeated fallback into incompatible decoder -> 500s spike.

jess (prod): action items (owners):
- akash: add admission check + unit tests (ETA 48h).
- maria: update runbook with `routesctl evict` steps & console menu (ETA 24h).
- prod infra: disallow `sticky_fallback` default for rollouts until compatibility checks are in place (ETA 72h).
- evan: coordinate customer comms and postmortem (ETA 24h).

maria (oncall): leaving follow-up notes in the ticket. closing this thread once postmortem is linked. Great response everyone :thumbsup:.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-884 created, linked to thread.

akash (sre): I'll own the writeup. cc: #eng-runtime for visibility.

jess (prod): adding a test to the canary pipeline to validate KV schema handshake between candidate and fallback variants.

maria (oncall): Thanks team. Marking incident as mitigated. We will reconvene for postmortem review in 48h. :white_check_mark:
